# llm.speech/v1

A model reads text aloud and returns the audio as a file. Every call names its model as `provider/model`: a provider the app's admins added in Settings → LLM, a slash, and
that provider's own id for the model. Shared types (`File`, `Usage`, `ModelInfo`, `Job`, the errors) are in
[`pocketone.dev/ext/contracts/llm`](https://github.com/pocketonehq/pocketone/blob/main/ext/contracts/llm/llm.go).

A wire contract at `/api/_c/llm.speech/v1` ([speech.go](https://github.com/pocketonehq/pocketone/blob/main/ext/contracts/llm/speech/v1/speech.go)), one provider. The
[llm](/docs/extensions/llm/extension) extension provides it, over Vultr, Cloudflare Workers AI, OpenRouter and any
OpenAI-compatible API.

## Use

In page code it's `$llm.speech` (bound by the llm extension):

```js
const r = await $llm.speech.speakAsync({ model: "vultr/qwen3-tts-12hz-1.7b", text: page, voice: "vivian", instructions: "slow and calm" })
record.set("narration", $llm.file(r.file))
await $llm.speech.voicesAsync("vultr/qwen3-tts-12hz-1.7b")
// a voice cloned from a stored clip: leave voice and instructions out
await $llm.speech.speakAsync({ model: "vultr/qwen3-tts-12hz-1.7b", text: page, reference: { audio: $llm.fromRecord(clip, "audio"), text: clip.getString("passage") } })
```

**Voice cloning.** `reference` (`{audio: File, text}`) asks the model to read in the voice of that clip; `text` is what
the clip says, optional but closer with it. A model clones when one of its voices has `mode: "clone"` (`voices`), and a
provider that doesn't clone answers `not_supported`. Nothing is saved at the provider: the clip goes with every call.
`instructions` can't go with a `reference`.

Over HTTP (a superuser, or a token with the scope shown):

| Operation | HTTP | Body | Token scope |
|---|---|---|---|
| Speak | `POST /api/_c/llm.speech/v1/speak` | `{"model": "...", "text": "...", "voice": "", "format": "mp3"}` | `llm` |
| Voices | `POST /api/_c/llm.speech/v1/voices` | `{"model": "..."}` | `llm:read` |
| Models | `GET /api/_c/llm.speech/v1/models` | `?provider=` (optional) | `llm:read` |

`speak` answers `{"file": File, "model", "usage"}`; `voices` answers `{"voices": [{"id", "name", "language", "mode",
"description"}]}` (empty when the provider doesn't list them; `mode` is `builtin`, `design` or `clone` when it says).

Errors: `not_configured` (no providers), `unknown_model`, `not_supported`, `provider` (the cloud's own error), `timeout`.

From Go: `speechv1.Contract.Must(app)` (from `pocketone.dev/ext/contracts/llm/speech/v1`).

## Provide

Implement `speechv1.Speech` and provide it in `Register` (`speechv1.Contract.Provide(app, impl)`). Route on the
`provider/` prefix, answer `not_supported` for a provider that can't do this kind, `unknown_model` for a missing model
or provider (and for a `reference` on a provider that can't clone), and `provider` with the cloud's own message (never its key) when the cloud refuses. Fill `model` with the
full `provider/model` that answered, and `usage` with what the provider reports.

## Commands and APIs

Every operation is a REST endpoint, a `pocketone` command and an MCP tool, all generated from the contract and behind the same token scope check and hooks. See [Remote CLI](/docs/features/remote), or the full [CLI](/docs/reference/cli), [Extension APIs](/docs/extensions/apis) and [MCP](/docs/reference/mcp) references.

### speak

Reads the text aloud and returns the audio.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/_c/llm.speech/v1/speak` |
| CLI | `pocketone remote llm speech speak --model <value> --text <value> --voice <value> --format <value> --speed <n> --instructions <value> --reference <json> --options <json>` |
| MCP | `llm_speech_speak` |
| Token scope | `llm` |

| Input field | Flag | Type |
|---|---|---|
| `model` | `--model` | string |
| `text` | `--text` | string |
| `voice` | `--voice` | string |
| `format` | `--format` | string |
| `speed` | `--speed` | float |
| `instructions` | `--instructions` | string |
| `reference` | `--reference` | json |
| `options` | `--options` | json |

### voices

Lists a model's voices, when the provider says.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/_c/llm.speech/v1/voices` |
| CLI | `pocketone remote llm speech voices --model <value>` |
| MCP | `llm_speech_voices` |
| Token scope | `llm:read` |

| Input field | Flag | Type |
|---|---|---|
| `model` | `--model` | string |

### models

Lists the speech models of every provider in Settings → LLM.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `GET /api/_c/llm.speech/v1/models` |
| CLI | `pocketone remote llm speech models --provider <value>` |
| MCP | `llm_speech_models` |
| Token scope | `llm:read` |

| Input field | Flag | Type |
|---|---|---|
| `provider` | `--provider` | string |
